cylinder_size.description: Water volume in litres of the cylinder a bar_min or psi_min rate is read on (both cylinders of a twinset, e.g. 24). Required to convert between a litres rate (l_min, cuft_min) and bar_min or psi_min; bar_min to psi_min needs none.

from.description: Unit of value: bar, psi, mpa (pressure); l, cuft (volume); m, ft (depth); c, f, k (temperature); kg, lb (weight); l_min, cuft_min, bar_min, psi_min (breathing_rate).

quantity.description: Kind of figure: pressure, volume, depth, temperature, weight or breathing_rate.

to.description: Unit to convert to, from the same list as from: bar, psi, mpa, l, cuft, m, ft, c, f, k, kg, lb, l_min, cuft_min, bar_min, psi_min.

value.description: The figure to convert: 0 or more, except a temperature.

name: convert_units

factor.description: Multiply by this to convert (absent for temperature, which has an offset).

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

title: Convert diving units
